name: host.io (API and domain pages)
operator: host.io (operator per the host.io terms, to be recorded by the reviewer)
tier_rationale: Commercial domain-data API with published terms and paid plans. P004's chair rationale says trusted, but P026 lists host.io as community: the stricter statement applies (a fragment may only be stricter).

reliability.justification: Crawled web and DNS relations (backlinks, redirects, shared analytics ids) of varying freshness; shared ids are capped hypotheses (P061).

hostio.description: host.io API token (header if the API supports it, else ?token= masked by the central redactor, AR01)
hostio.plan_hint: a company/team account (never an analyst's personal free account) on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded as key_plans.hostio with the terms URL before corporate use (P004)

api.title: host.io API (web, dns, related, full; domains by ip/ns/mx/asn/backlinks/redirects/adsense/googleanalytics)

terms.quote: Key-terms: the key belongs to a company/team account, never an analyst's personal free account, on a plan whose terms permit internal business use. The plan (key_plans.hostio) and terms URL are recorded in the registry before it runs under the corporate profile (A1).

api.notes: Quote: binding council text (P004 cond 2). /api/web/{domain}, /api/related/{domain} and /api/domains/{field}/{value} for googleanalytics, adsense, redirects, backlinks and ipinfo (research C0013); run_on seeds, at most 5 requests per entity, cache 7 days (P004). Error-in-200 bodies (invalid key, quota, throttling) map through P321 markers the owning batch adds with fixtures, never EMPTY.

domain_pages.title: host.io domain pages host.io/{domain} (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Host tiers are stated per A8; the pack itself sends nothing (tier n/a, terms open, default-on per A3 as manual links).

domain_pages.notes: Quote: council chair rationale (P026). host.io/{domain} is the hostio manual_link (P004) and a pivots_domain_dns template (research C0060). V3LUM never fetches pivot links itself (P311).

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G01-1, p2-G03-1, p2-G14-1: batches only extend it (hostio__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Profile ttl 7 days so the P004 cache_ttl (7 days) is not capped. No quota block yet: the monthly plan budget (<= 80% of the plan, P004) is added when legal records key_plans.hostio; no figure is recorded today. analytics_ids pivots to hostio and has no own client (P061).
